source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 4, 13. Αἷμα δίκαιον κυρίως τὸ τοῦ σωτῆρος Χριστοῦ, ὅπερ ἐκχέαντες τελέως ἀπώλοντο, ἐπὶ τοῖς τῶν προφητῶν αἵμασι μετρίως σωφρονιζόμενοι.
pass_a_gloss: [Pass A] Just blood chiefly is that of the Savior Christ, which having poured out they completely perished, being moderately chastened upon the prophets’ bloods.
pass_b_english: Just blood chiefly is that of the Savior Christ, which having poured out they completely perished, being moderately chastened upon the prophets’ bloods (Lamentations 4:13).

choices.why: Symmachus/Theodotion gloss Origen cites at Lam 4:7.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Origen’s Greek Lamentations fragments. Sense checked against Klostermann GCS III. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation.

apparatus.note: Source Greek OCR-noisy; restorations disclosed in translator_notes.
